description: Deterministic 64-dim feature hash of intent text string
One-hot identity of active workflow (LOGIN, SEARCH, PROFILE, CHECKOUT)
Binary indicator if a previous action was executed in current episode
Structural tag/type/attr features of last selected candidate
Binary indicator if previous action satisfied step validation
Deterministic 64-dim feature hash of serialized public text attributes
One-hot tag encoding (input, button, a, select, textarea, div, text_node, other)
One-hot element type encoding (text, password, submit, button, checkbox_radio, other)
Flags for visible, enabled, has_text, has_placeholder, has_aria, attr_count_norm
Viewport-normalized geometry (x, y, width, height, center_x, center_y, area_ratio)
Int8 mask (1 for extracted candidate, 0 for zero-padding)
